title: Persistent one-session ownership and broker boundary
summary: Persistent ownership prevents each observer/controller from creating a new IBM i login. TerminalSessionOwner retains the one live session; broker/protocol/socket layers expose bounded authenticated capabilities without transferring terminal ownership.
invariants: One real host session is preferable to session proliferation.
Broker clients do not own the live TN5250 transport.
Local IPC authentication/integrity does not implicitly confer terminal mutation authority.
Socket/service objects must not leak terminal owner, peer keys or live capability references through introspection.

provenance.claim: Supports this Terminal Machine/TN5250 continuity article.
